label: PF Backlog 586
title: EDP-05: Residency & Transfer Policy Registry (versioned, fail-closed) + IN-v1/US-v1 launch profiles (counsel-owned content)
body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.

brief.problem: No versioned, fail-closed residency/transfer policy registry for launch regions.
brief.why: Region launches blocked without enforceable residency policy source-of-truth.
brief.who_feels: Compliance, tenants in IN/US, and provisioning pipeline.

objective: Deliver a versioned, fail-closed residency and transfer policy registry with IN-v1 and US-v1 launch profiles whose content is owned by counsel.
acceptance_criteria: Registry versions policies and fails closed on unknown/missing region
IN-v1 and US-v1 profiles load from config and validate
Policy evaluation delegated to BI-PF-1303 interfaces
approach: Mirror existing policy-registry pattern; content injected via config.
verification: Unit tests: fail-closed paths, profile loading
risks: Boundary drift with BI-PF-1303 causing duplicate policy logic
rollback: Disable registry feature flag; keep prior default deny.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/artifact_registry.py, core/change_policy.py, core/change_registry.py, core/context_policy.py

consolidation_proposal.title: EDP-05: Residency & Transfer Policy Registry (versioned, fail-closed) + IN-v1/US-v1 launch profiles (counsel-owned content)
consolidation_proposal.body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.
acceptance_criteria: Registry stores policy_id, jurisdiction, version/effective date, approver, data classes, allowed primary/replica/backup regions, support locations, subprocessor allowlist, retention, transfer mechanisms.
IN-v1 and US-v1 profiles exist as data, marked counsel-owned, not code constants.
tenant.home_region, jurisdiction_profile_id, residency_policy_version are set at provisioning from authenticated config (never from X-Tenant-Id/X-Region/URL).
Provisioning fails closed if any required service (DB/object/backup/logs/KMS/queue/cache/vector/workers/model) lacks an approved region.
Region is immutable to ordinary users; changes require an audited migration plan.
ADR document committed covering storage layers, backends, and data-flow decisions
Develop commit SHA pinned and recorded
The 11 interfaces are declared with explicit optional capabilities (versioning/lock/conditional-write/KMS/signed-URL/multipart).
A conformance suite runs against any adapter (starting with WorkerGrid's store as reference).
No domain module depends on a concrete provider.
private buckets, least-privilege credentials, lifecycle/versioning where required; explicit region/backup/replication capability metadata.
Signed URLs only after authorization, constrained to object/method, short TTL.
Provider config stays inside the adapter; conformance suite passes (wrong-region, versions, delete, restore).

context_review.reason: Registry mechanics and patterns are known; content and cross-item interface need human decisions.

api_impact.reason: retrofit assessment (ADR-0007): no external API consumer recorded; treated as internal until an API surface is required (then set needs_api=true with routes)
